name: config-hooks
description: Verify config hooks system loads without errors during startup. The hooks file is written into the spec's own project folder (the runner's throwaway one), where the app runs, never into the repo folder the developer's live agents use.

config.command: bash -c 'R=$PWD; cd "$KOLLAB_PROJECT_ROOT" && mkdir -p .kollab && echo "{\"hooks\":{\"UserPromptSubmit\":[{\"hooks\":[{\"type\":\"command\",\"command\":\"echo ok\"}]}]}}" > .kollab/hooks.json && python "$R/main.py"'

steps.title: Test 1: App starts normally with hooks.json

steps.description: App started with config hooks loaded

steps.title: Test 2: The hooks file in the project folder is the one loaded

steps.description: Log says the config hooks came from hooks.json

steps.title: Test 3: No crash or error visible

steps.description: No config hook errors in output
